text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital finishes strong in her
important
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The base... is the peak...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The base is the peak... The very first
starting
gate... A distance not yet
grasped... Entangled
legs...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Splashes of perspiration. Blind with
adrenaline.
Quiet blankets the cheering.
Only the scoreboard
is visible.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The emotional weight of it all is
practically
unbearable! You get it, right?
Can you feel it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... And here I am, smooshed in among all these fresh young Umas as they run with fervor thrust into every step...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I underestimated how consuming the
debut race
would be! We're all winners!
All of us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital appears thrilled to have
run
alongside so many other rookie
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, today's race is just the very
beginning, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
From this point forward, there'll be loads
of
Umamusume waiting for me, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, it can't get any better than this!
I've taken
my first step through the
gates of paradise! I've
made it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And now, the simping begins! I'll simp on
turf! I'll
simp on dirt! I'll simp until I can
simp no more!
Let's head to the next
one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh... right. Since today was dirt,
next up
should be turf...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Digitan! Pull it together! We
gotta think
about this more seriously.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Today was way too intense
because it was
a debut race... Because of
that, the others
practically shot across
the track.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You know, I haven't quite had my fill of
watching
Umas play in the dirt! I'd like a
second helping of
it, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to gear up for the
Hyacinth
Stakes at the beginning of next
year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next year... That's kinda far off, though.
Guess
that just gives me more time to
run and prep...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's spend that time building karma as
well. After
all, I'd like to get to know all
the different types
of Umamusume more
deeply. At arm's length, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having just begun our journey into the
Twinkle
Series, we need to take every
opportunity to
make new connections
and increase our
knowledge as we
prepare for the Hyacinth Stakes.
